## Fixes

- **Walkability edits can no longer leave tiles missing.** In "This map only" mode, a stroke copies the affected tiles, with their new flags, into the level type's own tile file, and switches the cells to those copies. Three checks now protect that:
  - **Before anything is written,** every cell the stroke changes must use a tile that the map's libraries or the new tile file really have. If not, nothing changes.
  - **After the stroke,** the map's tile libraries are read back as the map now loads them. If any changed cell can't find its tile (the tile file didn't load, or the level type doesn't list it), the stroke is undone straight away and the message says why.
  - **"Save tile flags"** ("The tiles themselves") checks that each rewritten DT1 reads back with the same tiles before writing it.
- **A walkability brush with nothing ticked** says so in the panel, and doesn't apply. The message explains how to make cells walkable: Remove flags with Block walking ticked, or the Make walkable quick brush.
